observations: Headers remains pub(crate) with private tuple fields; take_local_redirect still returns Option<LocalRedirect> by value. No new public Box type or callable mint was added.
Option::take clears the stored option before consuming Box. Mapping dereferences the owned Box exactly once; this moves the existing LocalRedirect rather than cloning it.
as_deref supplies the same borrowed LocalRedirect to the unchanged method; deadline/current-profile matching is unchanged.
copy_for_forward's existing self.1.clone() now deep-clones Box<LocalRedirect>; LocalRedirect was already Clone. No new sharing, reference counting or extra logical clone call was introduced.

Headers::drop, serde rejection for a present local capsule, bounded map codec, into_local_redirect_metadata and quota methods are byte-identical. Normal Rust field destruction still drops a retained Box and its LocalRedirect after Headers::drop.
The new size_of<Response>() assertion is a test gate only. This review has not measured a layout or run Rust/Clippy and does not infer all result_large_err sites are resolved.
